prompt: I'm working on a DoD contract and we need to migrate about 200 VMs from our current VMware vSphere 7 environment to something that doesn't require VMware licensing (Broadcom situation is killing us). The environment is IL5 rated, completely air-gapped, no internet access whatsoever. We're thinking KubeVirt on RKE2 Government but open to other ideas. Need to maintain our ATO. What's the migration plan and target architecture look like?

assertions.name: kubevirt_or_alternative
assertions.description: Recommends KubeVirt on RKE2 Gov or explains alternative platform choice with rationale

assertions.name: air_gap_strategy
assertions.description: Addresses air-gapped deployment in detail (disconnected registries, offline packages, media transfer)

assertions.name: il5_compliance
assertions.description: Addresses IL5 requirements and what that means architecturally (NIST 800-53, DISA STIGs)

assertions.name: ato_continuity
assertions.description: Discusses ATO maintenance or RMF process during migration

assertions.name: migration_phases
assertions.description: Provides phased migration plan (not just target state)

assertions.name: vm_conversion_tooling
assertions.description: Mentions specific tools or methods for converting VMware VMs to KubeVirt format

assertions.name: stig_hardening
assertions.description: Mentions STIG hardening for the target platform

assertions.name: disconnected_registry
assertions.description: Covers container registry strategy for air-gapped environment (Harbor, Iron Bank, etc.)

assertions.name: storage_strategy
assertions.description: Covers storage for KubeVirt VMs (Ceph/Rook, Longhorn, or similar)

assertions.name: rollback_plan
assertions.description: Includes rollback or risk mitigation strategy
